description: oriiion STAFF ONLY. Show the customer something on their onboarding page: kind website asks them to confirm their site (title and share image fetched by the server; confirming it starts the build), kind brand asks them to approve the logo, colours and fonts currently on their account — both pop up for the customer, who can also leave them for later. Kind note is a message in the chat beside the onboarding (also how you answer the customer's chat messages). A new website or brand card replaces an unanswered one.

kind.description: website: ask the customer to confirm their site (the server fetches its title and share image). brand: ask them to approve the logo, colours and fonts as they stand on the account now. note: a short message, nothing to answer.

message.description: A short line in the customer's language, shown on the card. Required for kind "note".

onboardingId.description: The onboardingId from the routine payload.

websiteUrl.description: For kind "website": the site to show. Defaults to the one the customer typed.
